notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
This update brings some quality of life improvements and a lot of restructuring.

Changes made in this patch:

Mouse support! You can now use left click instead of enter and right click instead of backspace.
Can now use the scroll wheel to cycle through slots
Can now exit dialogue with right click / backspace
Can now use arrow keys instead of WASD (although this is not recommended)
Lanterns deactivate closer to surface
Reworked save system and lots of other code to prepare for future updates!
Other minor improvements
